channel.title: WattFigures
channel.description: Interactive calculators and plain-English running costs for every appliance in your home: electricity use, standby drain, EV charging and more.

item.title: Electric Blanket Running Cost: Per Night and Per Winter
item.description: A 100 W electric blanket uses 0.2 kWh a night, 24 kWh a winter — about $4.32 in the US. What it costs in 23 countries, and what it really replaces.

item.title: Space Heater Running Cost: Per Hour, Per Day and Per Winter
item.description: What a plug-in electric heater really costs per hour, per day and per season, with worked examples at real prices and cheaper ways to stay warm.

item.title: Contracted Power in Spain: How Many kW Do You Need?
item.description: How Spain's contracted power charge works, why tripping your breaker means you're undersized, and how to size it right without overpaying.

item.title: EU Energy Label Explained: A–G and kWh/Year
item.description: How to read the EU energy label — what the letter grade means, why kWh/year predicts your bill, and where the old A+++ scale went.

item.title: Why Is My Electricity Bill So High?
item.description: Before you panic about a shocking bill, check these usual suspects — from an appliance stuck running to a contract that no longer fits your home.

item.title: Heat Pump vs Gas Boiler: Is It Cheaper?
item.description: A heat pump beats a gas boiler above one number: the break-even COP. It runs from 1.2 in Sweden to 3.6 in Belgium — the same machine, opposite verdicts.

item.title: Air Conditioning Running Cost Calculator
item.description: See what your air conditioner costs to run per hour, per day and per cooling season from its power draw, daily hours and your electricity price.

item.title: Electricity Cost Calculator: Cost to Run Anything
item.description: Work out what any appliance costs to run per day, month and year from its wattage, hours of use and your price per kWh.

item.title: EV Home Charging Cost Calculator
item.description: Estimate what charging your electric car at home costs — per full charge, per 100 km and per year — from your battery, efficiency and price per kWh.

item.title: Heat Pump vs Gas Boiler Cost Calculator
item.description: Compare a year of heating with a heat pump versus a gas boiler using your heat demand, the heat pump COP, boiler efficiency and fuel prices.

item.title: Washer and Dryer Running Cost Calculator
item.description: Estimate what your washing machine and tumble dryer cost per cycle, per week and per year from their energy per cycle and your electricity price.

item.title: LED vs Halogen Savings Calculator
item.description: See how much you save each year by switching bulbs to LED, and how fast the change pays for itself, based on wattages, hours and your electricity price.

item.title: Solar Panel Payback Calculator
item.description: Estimate how many years a home solar system takes to pay for itself, from size, cost, yield, self-consumption and your electricity and export prices.

item.title: Standby Power Calculator: Vampire Devices
item.description: Add up what your always-on gadgets cost while 'off'. Estimate the yearly and monthly cost of standby (vampire) power across your home.

item.title: How to Cut Standby Power at Home
item.description: A step-by-step plan to find and kill the vampire power your devices draw while switched off, and how much you can realistically save.

item.title: Time-of-Use Tariffs Explained
item.description: What time-of-use and off-peak electricity tariffs are, who they suit, and how shifting usage to cheaper hours can cut your bill.

item.title: How to Understand Your Electricity Bill
item.description: Decode your electricity bill line by line: the unit rate, standing charge, taxes and what actually drives the total you pay each month.

item.title: Vampire Device Audit: A Room-by-Room Checklist
item.description: A printable room-by-room checklist to hunt down the always-on devices quietly adding to your electricity bill, and what to do about each.
